FieldMedTest0000.description: Heroic/Scholar. Your Medicine roll vs the flat DC 15 printed on the card (the Grand Deception shape). 2bZ (iron rule 2b): was a name-keyed useItem hook. On a failure the focus is still spent.

handler.note: DC 15 — on a failure the focus is still spent.

FieldMedHeal0000.description: Heroic/Scholar. On a success the patient heals their OWN recovery die + your Medicine ranks — the target-die half is H17 (2bZ): @target.recoveryDie resolves against the patient, the rest against you. Relay-safe (you rarely own the patient's actor). ⚑ recovery-die read path bench-unverified.

FieldMedResusc00.description: Heroic/Scholar. The Resuscitation UPSELL (the pass-F whenOwnsTalent exit): this line only prints if you also own Resuscitation, whose own document carries no rule — its 3-focus cost rides its own activation. Declared in the heroic tree-section header.

handler.text: Resuscitation: you may instead spend 3 focus to revive an Unconscious or just-dead patient.
